insert into cs_retain_issue_comments ( uuid, issue_kee, change_data, user_uuid, issue_change_creation_date ) select ic.uuid, ic.issue_key, ic.change_data, ic.user_login, ic.issue_change_creation_date from issue_changes ic where ic.project_uuid = #{branchUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and ic.issue_key in (select t.issue_kee from cs_issue_track_for_retain t where t.branch_uuid = #{branchUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) and ic.change_type = 'comment' and not exists (select 1 from cs_retain_issue_comments c where c.uuid = ic.uuid)
